entries.title: Psalms 150:1
segments: ¶Hallelujah! Praise *God in his sanctuary; praise him in the firmament of his power.

entries.title: Psalms 150:2
segments: Praise him in his mighty acts; praise him according to the abundance of his greatness.

entries.title: Psalms 150:3
segments: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet; praise him with lute and harp;

entries.title: Psalms 150:4
segments: Praise him with the tambour and dance; praise him with stringed instruments and the pipe;

entries.title: Psalms 150:5
segments: Praise him with loud cymbals; praise him with high sounding cymbals.

entries.title: Psalms 150:6
segments: Let everything that hath breath praise Jah. Hallelujah!
